class.name: SteamLocalizedText
class.brief_description: Immutable localization token and variables for one Steam notification text.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates immutable text with a Steam localization token and detached substitutions. Use a leading [code]#[/code], up to 128 UTF-8 token bytes, and up to 8 substitutions. The service checks these bounds before submission.

method.name: get_token
method.description: Return the localization token, including its leading #.

members.member: Detached localization variables keyed by their Steam token names.
